notes:
REF-BM-02: Collects title and description only; favicon and preview image are missing.
REF-BM-03: No manual title or description editing before or after save.
REF-BM-04: Tags can only be added; URL, title, description, and note cannot be edited, and tags cannot be removed.
REF-BM-05: No bookmark deletion operation exists.
REF-BM-07: Cards expose title, description, and tags, but use a generated initial instead of a favicon.
REF-BM-10: Tag inputs provide no existing-tag autocomplete.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title and description only, not note or URL.
REF-BM-14: The #tag search syntax is unsupported.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised search expressions are unsupported.
REF-BM-16: Quoted exact-phrase parsing is unsupported.
REF-BM-18: There is no separate unread-only view.
REF-BM-19: Read status can be set, but there is no unread list from which the bookmark is removed.
REF-BM-20: No multi-selection or bulk actions exist.
REF-BM-21: No whole-filtered-collection bulk action exists.
REF-BM-22: Results use one fixed updated-time ordering with no selectable sort key.
REF-BM-23: Notes and markdown rendering are not implemented.
REF-BM-24: Local HTML snapshots and PDF snapshot handling are not implemented.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is not implemented.
REF-BM-27: Archive and restore exist, but permanent deletion does not, so the full distinction is missing.
REF-BM-29: Saved filter bundles are not implemented.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is not implemented.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is not implemented.
REF-BM-32: Display-related personal settings are not implemented.
